statusHistory.note: Operator-commissioned (West Hollywood/LA hip-spots war room, 2026-11-04), fifth pin in the cluster, Silver Lake. The originally scoped venue, Black Hogg (2852 Sunset Blvd), was found permanently closed on live verification (claude-in-chrome Google Maps check, 2026-11-04) -- the address now hosts Bodega Park, run by the same ownership team (Black Hogg closed March 2020 per LAist/Infatuation; Bodega Park's own Instagram handle, @blackhoggsandwiches, is the literal legacy handle). Per the verify-still-open-before-create rule, Black Hogg was not created; operator approved the Bodega Park substitution in-session before drafting began. Verified open via live Google Maps listing (4.6/251 reviews) and claude-in-chrome for exact coordinates. Research floor: The Infatuation, LAist, Fox 11 LA (local broadcast, independently covers the Food & Wine ranking), Discover Los Angeles, Eastsider LA, Locale Magazine -- six preferred-source-type consults, exceeding the five-source floor. Reddit leg: searched (site:reddit.com and general), no usable thread surfaced on this specific venue -- logged as a floor gap, not fabricated. Google reviews leg: read live via claude-in-chrome; recent reviews consistently praise the chopped cheese, bacon-egg-cheese and pork bulgogi sandwiches with no notable recent negative pattern found. Real texture used: ranked #2 best sandwich shop in America by Food & Wine; concept blends NYC bodega-sandwich culture with the owners' Korean and LA roots (Peruvian chicken breakfast burritos also cited). Hero image supplied by the operator, 1600x1023, clears the Discover spec. Full six-locale coverage done inline, single coordinator, no subagents. Headline leads with a concrete USP (the Korean-bodega sandwich fusion, not a generic sandwich shop) and avoids the 'The X that Y' construction per operator instruction.
